LEGAL & COMPLIANCE

Privacy Policy &
POPIA Compliance

Deep Blue Aquatic Systems (Pty) Ltd is committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring transparency in how personal information is gathered and processed in accordance with South Africa's Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA).

1. Responsible Party

This policy applies to Deep Blue Aquatic Systems (Pty) Ltd, registered in the Republic of South Africa, with our primary office and engineering workshop located at 185 Mills Street, Gants Plaza, Strand 7140, Western Cape.

2. Information We Collect

We collect information that you voluntarily provide when enquiring about our engineering solutions, requesting a quote, or engaging with our technical desk. This may include:

  • Name and surname
  • Business or farm name
  • Telephone and WhatsApp contact number
  • Email address
  • Project location, site specifications, and engineering requirements

3. Purpose of Processing

We process your personal information exclusively for legitimate business purposes:

  • To prepare technical proposals, engineering designs, and commercial quotations;
  • To communicate regarding ongoing projects, installations, or equipment maintenance;
  • To respond to enquiries submitted via phone, email, contact forms, or technical chat;
  • To fulfill contractual commitments, equipment warranties, and regulatory compliance.

4. Data Storage & Security

We employ appropriate administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect personal data against unauthorized access, loss, destruction, or alteration. We do not sell, rent, or lease client lists to third parties.

5. Your Rights Under POPIA

In accordance with POPIA, you have the right to request access to personal information we hold about you, request the correction of inaccurate data, or request the deletion of your records, subject to statutory retention requirements.

6. Contact Our Information Officer

If you have any questions or wish to exercise your rights under POPIA, please contact our office:
